item.title: RCSO dismantles ‘Youngins with Money’ gang in ongoing drug busts
item.description: Authorities say a coordinated gang enforcement operation led to multiple arrests, the seizure of large amounts of drugs and cash, and the takedown of a suspected gang leader tied to criminal activity across Augusta and Grovetown. The post RCSO dismantles ‘Youngins with Money’ gang in ongoing drug busts appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Fani Willis testifies to Georgia Senate committee
item.description: After more than a year of rebuffing Republican attempts to compel her testimony before the Georgia Senate, Fani Willis went to the state Capitol Wednesday to give three hours of often combative testimony to a special committee that she deemed to be a political farce. The post Fani Willis testifies to Georgia Senate committee appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: VA grant opportunity could fund long-planned veterans cemetery in Augusta
item.description: A new federal grant opportunity could provide up to $10 million to support construction of a long-awaited state veterans cemetery in Augusta, marking a major milestone in a project that has been decades in the making. The post VA grant opportunity could fund long-planned veterans cemetery in Augusta appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Westminster football program to transition from 8-man to 11-man football
item.description: In a letter sent to players, families, and supporters, Westminster Head of School Dr. Shawn M. Brower announced the school’s football program will transition from 8-man to 11-man play beginning next season. The post Westminster football program to transition from 8-man to 11-man football appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Aviation Commission to assign StandardAero property to Augusta Development Authority
item.description: The Augusta Aviation Commission approved assigning the Hangar Road property where the expanded StandardAero maintenance facility is located to the Augusta Economic Development Authority (AEDA), during a special called meeting Wednesday morning. The post Aviation Commission to assign StandardAero property to Augusta Development Authority appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: A local realtor has gone missing after a boating incident off the Georgia coast, the Realtors of Greater Augusta (RGA) announced, Thursday. The post Local real estate broker missing after boating incident appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Salvation Army Augusta spreads gifts and Christmas cheer during its Angel Tree Distribution Day
item.description: A line of cars down Tate Street wrapped through the parking lot at the building of what was Terrace Manor Elementary School, Thursday morning, as families stopped by to pick up Christmas gifts for their children via the Salvation Army’s annual Angel Tree campaign.
